verdict.rationale: Plausible's docs describe a single lightweight script that automatically tracks pageviews, and 'goals' that automatically capture outbound link clicks, file downloads, and form completions without custom code, plus automatic scroll-depth tracking with 'no setup, no tag managers.' This directly matches the story of capturing pageviews, clicks, and form interactions without per-event instrumentation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration specifically validating automatic click/form-goal tracking accuracy (community evidence covers UX/pricing/self-hosting but not this specific automatic-event capability), and no mention of automatic capture beyond these three event types (e.g., no broader autotrack for arbitrary custom interactions).
